name: ShadcnImage
description: Themed rounded image slot with a placeholder while loading and a caller-supplied error slot on failure.

fields.background: ThemedColor? - fill behind the image and the default placeholder
fields.duration: Duration? - fade-in of the decoded picture; default 150ms

notes: The widget is `ShadcnImage`, not `Image`: package:flutter/widgets.dart exports an `Image`, so a plain `Image` would make any file importing both libraries fail to compile. Same rule as ShadcnTheme.

`ImageTheme`, `ImageErrorBuilder`, `imageDefaults` and `imageThemeOverrides` keep their plain names - audited against every library widgets.dart re-exports (widgets, painting, rendering, foundation, animation, services, gestures, scheduler, semantics, physics) and declared in no Flutter name list.
The component resolves the stream itself (ImageProvider -> ImageStream -> RawImage) so it can keep a placeholder layer and a fade-in without Flutter's Image widget.
